name: Miku
source: A high school student Tsuyoshi bumps into with bread in her mouth. She is bright and cheerful, and instead of apologizing, she gives him her half-eaten bread. Tsuyoshi is surprised by the sudden indirect kiss. The same thing happens many times, and the two of them keep getting closer with each other, but...
